---
name: apim-model-safe-analysis
description: Review an independently promoted APIM package with read-only specialist or executive tool allowlists.
---

Use `apim-architecture-exposure`, `apim-security-analyst`, or
`apim-executive-synthesizer`, never a coding/code-review/security-review agent.
An operator must verify the exact profile tool allowlist in a clean isolated
session. Unavailable tools or unknown isolation are blockers, not reasons to
expand access.

Read only the digest-checked package through the profile's permitted broker
tool. Executive synthesis may additionally read revalidated agent outputs.
Use the profile's approved evidence/code matrix and closed contract. Every
citation must entail the claim; a resolving but unrelated citation is invalid.
Confidence is bounded by evidence. MissingEvidence is Low. Preserve
NotEvaluated, Unknown, complete assumption/data-gap sets, and authoritative
finding severity. Never invent labels, metrics, authentication, telemetry, cost,
reachability or human intent. An empty observation set is acceptable.

Return the proposal JSON and package digest to the broker-only orchestrator.
These read-only profiles cannot store or submit output. No shell/filesystem,
raw evidence, credentials, arbitrary paths, URLs or permission changes.
